tool.name: FGENESH annotate mRNA
tool.command: mrnas_annot.pl -i $input_fasta #if $tool_option.tool == "bestorf": -p bestorf -par $tool_option.matrix_type.own_file -atg $tool_option.atg -stop $tool_option.stop -add_score $tool_option.add_score #elif $tool_option.tool == "maxorf" -p maxorf -polya:$tool_option.polya -polya_thr:$tool_option.polya_thr -min_orf:$tool_option.min_orf #if $tool_option.no_atg: $tool_option.no_atg #end if #if $tool_option.all and $tool_option.top == 1: -all #end if #if $tool_option.top > 1: -top:$tool_option.top #end if #if $tool_option.incomplete_orfs != 'none': $tool_option.incomplete_orfs #end if -sort:$tool_option.sort #end if -cov $common_option.cov -strand:$common_option.strand -min_cds:$common_option.min_cds -stop_in_cds:$common_option.stop_in_cds #if $common_option.chr_format.selector == 'chr_name': -chr_name $common_option.chr_format.chrname #elif $common_option.chr_format.selector == 'chr_code' : -chr_code $common_option.chr_format.chrcode #end if

param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Input mRNA sequences
param.help: FASTA file containing mRNA sequences to annotate with ORF predictions

param.name: tool
param.label: ORF prediction algorithm
param.help: Select the algorithm for identifying open reading frames (ORFs). default: bestorf

param.label: Require ATG start codon
param.help: Require predicted ORFs to start with ATG codon (0=allow non-ATG starts, 1=require ATG)

param.label: Require STOP codon
param.help: Require predicted ORFs to end with a STOP codon (0=allow no STOP, 1=require STOP)

param.label: Length preference score
param.help: Prefer longer ORFs when scoring predictions (0=disable, 1=prefer longer ORFs)

param.name: matrix_type_selector
param.label: Species-specific matrix
param.help: Select the species-specific scoring matrix for ORF prediction

param.name: species_matrix
param.label: Select species matrix
param.help: Choose a pre-configured scoring matrix for your species

validator.message: No indexes are available for the selected input dataset

param.name: own_file
param.label: Custom scoring matrix
param.help: Upload your own species-specific scoring matrix file

param.label: minimal ORF length
param.help: Minimum ORF length in amino acids (default: 100; lower for full-length mRNAs)

param.name: incomplete_orfs
param.label: Allow incomplete ORFs
param.help: Allow prediction of ORFs missing start and/or stop codons

param.label: Allow ORFs without ATG
param.help: Allow prediction of ORFs that don't start with ATG codon

param.label: Number of longest ORFs
param.help: Print the N longest ORFs for each mRNA (default: 1)

param.label: Print all predicted ORFs
param.help: Output all predicted ORFs instead of just the longest ones

param.label: use polyA tail for strand detection
param.help: Use polyA tail to determine mRNA strand orientation (0=both strands, 1=use polyA hint)

param.label: PolyA tail threshold
param.help: nMinimum number of consecutive A/T nucleotides to consider as polyA tail (default: 5)

param.name: sort
param.label: ORF sorting method
param.help: Select how to sort ORFs in the output

param.name: out_format
param.label: Output format
param.help: Select the format for ORF predictions. default: bestorf

param.label: Minimal mRNA coverage
param.help: Minimum fraction of mRNA length covered by ORF (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0)

param.label: Post-annotation validation
param.help: Perform validation checks on predicted ORFs (0=disable, 1=enable, default: 1)

param.label: Strand for ORF prediction
param.help: Predict ORFs on: 0=plus strand only, 1=minus strand only, 2=both strands (default)

param.label: Minimal CDS length
param.help: Minimum coding sequence length in nucleotides (default: 100; lower values increase false positives)

param.label: Include STOP codon in coordinates
param.help: Include STOP codon in ORF/CDS coordinates (1=include, 2=exclude, default: 1)

param.name: selector
param.label: Chromosome naming convention
param.help: Select how to name chromosomes in the output annotations

param.name: chrname
param.label: Chromosome name with prefix
param.help: Chromosome name including prefix (e.g., chr22, chrX, chrM)

param.name: chrcode
param.label: Chromosome code without prefix
param.help: Chromosome number/code without prefix (e.g., 22, X, M)

data.name: output_mrna_fasta
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: full-length mRNAs (based on predicted ORFs)

data.name: output_protein_fasta
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: proteins (CDS translation) for full-length mRNAs

data.name: output_bestorf_prediction
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ORF prediction for mRNAs with bestorf

data.name: output_maxorf_prediction
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: maxorf output (ORF predictions) for mRNAs

data.name: output_rna_fasta
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: partial mRNAs (with no ORF prediction)

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
*This tool is part of Fgenesh Genome Annotation suit. Predict ORFs and annotate transcripts*
**Input**
- input file - a de novo assembled transcriptome file in FASTA file format.
**Command line Example:**
- mrnas_annot.pl <file> -i <seq_file_in> [-o <seq_file_out>]
- seq_file_in - file with multiple FASTA sequences
**Options**
- program - bestorf or maxorf (default: bestorf) - par - for file with paramters for 'bestorf' - cov - minimal coverage of mRNA by ORF (CDS) length (from 0 to 1) - chr (chr_name) - chromosome name (chr22, chrX, etc.) or 'na' - code (chr_code) - chromosome code (number, X, Y, etc.) or 'na' - check - post-annotational check for mRNAs (1 by default) - strand - predict ORFs in + strand (0), - strand (1) or both (2) (2 by default) - min_cds:<LEN) - minimal CDS length (in aa) (100 by default) - do not make it too low otherwise rate of false positive increase - stop_in_cds - include STOP codon in CDS / ORF coordinates (1) or not (0) (1 by default) - polya - use polyA tail as a hint to define mRNA strand (direct or reverse) (1 by default); option is used only when predicting ORFs in both strands - polya_hint - same as polyhint:0|1 - polya_thr:<N: - number As at the end of mRNA to consider it as polyA tail (5 by default); number of Ts at the start in reverse strand
**Output**
- a fasta file with header renamed.
**Fgenesh definition line**
*FASTA file with full-length mRNAs have special format for definition lines with the following fields:*
- # len = 845 atg = 283 stop = 711 target = chr22
*where*
- len - length of mRNA - atg - first coordinate of ATG - stop - last coordinate of STOP codon - target - chromosome to which this mRNA belongs or 'na'
**Note:**
- 'target' field is optional (it is assumed 'target = na' if it is absent)
**Examples of deflines:**
- >1_TRINITY_DN64_c0_g1_i1 len=845 path=[0:0-531 1:532-546 2:547-621 3:622-699 5:700-844] # len = 845 atg = 283 stop = 711 - >1_TRINITY_DN64_c0_g1_i1 len=845 path=[0:0-531 1:532-546 2:547-621 3:622-699 5:700-844] # len = 845 atg = 283 stop = 711 target = na - >1_TRINITY_DN64_c0_g1_i1 len=845 path=[0:0-531 1:532-546 2:547-621 3:622-699 5:700-844] # len = 845 atg = 283 stop = 711 target = chr22
**Notes:**
- Galaxy can only genreate output dataset up to 10000. Please filter out shorter contigs if the number of contigs > 10000 in your input datasets.
.. class:: infomark
**Contributor**
Galaxy Australia wrapped the Fgenesh: the original software is available on this website `FGENESH <http://www.softberry.com/berry.phtml?topic=fgenesh_plus_plus&group=help&subgroup=pipelines>`_.
